Interface ProtocolRuntime<S>

Type Parameters:
S - protocol-specific state type
All Superinterfaces:
AutoCloseable
All Known Implementing Classes:
MeshCoreCompanionProtocolRuntime, MeshCoreKissProtocolRuntime, MeshtasticProtocolRuntime
public interface ProtocolRuntime<S> extends AutoCloseable
Runtime instance for one communication protocol over one transport connection.

A runtime connects the transport to protocol services: incoming-message listeners, initial handshake or config exchange, device state, and post-connect actions.
